content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JMI Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JMI Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Field Investigator post at Jamia Millia Islamia is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Field Investigator role at JMI?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates must have a Post Graduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month for the Field Investigator position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the JMI Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents attached. Ensure you follow the instructions carefully and send it before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification to assess the suitability of the candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Field Investigator in this recruitment drive by Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position is a contractual role, offering a fixed-term employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is New Delhi, under Jamia Millia Islamia.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: While the job is located in New Delhi, candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply provided they meet the specified qualification criteria.
